title: How does world-model governance differ from LLM and agent governance?
summary: World-model governance must validate the modelled environment, not only content and action permissions.
body: Language-model governance often focuses on generated content. Agent governance focuses on authority to act. World models add a third concern: whether the modelled environment is valid enough for its intended use. A false model of reality can silently propagate errors into training, testing, planning and action.
